title: mlassure custody bundle manifest, format 1
description: Machine-readable form of SPEC.md section 4. Structural validity only: the root-hash construction (SPEC section 4.1), file existence, and byte hashes are checked by the verifier (SPEC section 5), not by this schema.

algorithm.description: Algorithm identifier for every digest in this manifest (files[].sha256 and rootHash). Mandatory; a verifier never assumes one.

path.description: Relative, /-separated, NFC-normalized; never absolute, never containing .. or backslash; never manifest.json or a signature artifact.
